fato_historico: 1814: The Convention of London, a treaty between the United Kingdom and the United Netherlands, is signed in London, England.

Much like long-standing treaties that foster new beginnings, consider how you can unite your inner passions with the world around you. It is a good time to negotiate boundaries and forge deep, lasting connections that honor your vibrant spirit and innate courage.
frase_do_dia: Strong foundations are built through the harmony of diverse and courageous spirits.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic energy of sudden, positive shifts and newfound clarity.
conselho: Trust your instincts and seek common ground in every conversation you have today.
